messages:
rachel: Pushed a new draft for the launch blog (Optimize). Main decisions: which CTA to prioritize, how to present benchmark appendix, and final inbound routing. Hoping for quick decisions today so design can finalize hero and CTA treatments.

elaine: Prefer a primary webinar CTA (low friction) with a secondary gated benchmark PDF in the sidebar. The PDF is the conversion driver but the webinar will get more immediate registrations. We should wire both to distinct HubSpot lists for attribution.

samir: Agree. Proposal: primary CTA -> Webinar (list: Launch - Optimize - Webinar); secondary CTA -> Gated Benchmark (list: Launch - Optimize - Benchmark). Also recommend tagging gated leads with lead_score_bucket=benchmark_high for easier routing.

maria: Legal quick-pass: the hero claim currently says "50% lower costs across the board" which we can't use. Change to: "in our benchmark tests, costs were reduced by up to 50%" and include a linked appendix with test parameters (model, sequence length, infra, configs). Once the appendix is attached I'll sign off.

nora: Design needs a final approved hero stat and the CTA copy. I'll produce two hero variants: stat-first and narrative-first, and two CTA button treatments (primary solid for webinar, outline for download). Export to CDN path /cdn/marketing/optimize-launch/ by EOD once copy locks.

rachel: Updated hero to Maria's wording and moved the full benchmark table to the appendix section. Also added a short explainer box on test rig (ML model, seq len, GPU type). Draft pushed.

samir: UTMs: use utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_q1, utm_content={webinar|benchmark}. For the short social clips add utm_content=video15|video30.

ops-bot: Publish checklist (auto): final copy, legal signoff, hero image + assets, gated PDF uploaded, HubSpot workflows staged, UTMs decided.

maria: I'll review the appendix now and post a pass here shortly. Reminder: appendix must include raw numbers and versions; otherwise OK.

elaine: Assuming legal OK, plan to publish Wed 08:30 PT. Josh/plumbing: can we also push a hidden form field source_detail=blog_bench for the download flow so ops can filter?

samir: Good call. Also set the HubSpot workflow to add property lead_origin=blog and set lifecycle stage to MQL for gated leads only. Webinar registrants get nurture sequence but no automatic MQL.

nora: I'll upload final hero + video variants and attach CDN links in this thread once ready.

rachel: Great. If Maria approves appendix by EOD, we'll lock copy and schedule publish. Thanks all. :tada:
